task: Put the key in the white box.
training_scope: official default: freeze VLM; update all 16 action expert layers, state and action interfaces
schedule_source: LeRobot SmolVLA defaults (lr 1e-4, betas 0.9/0.95, weight decay 1e-10, clip 10, warmup 1000, cosine to 2.5e-6), shortened to 10000 steps; effective batch 64 = 16 x 4 accumulation on the local RTX 4060 8 GB
data_scope: first real-arm baseline: 49 teleoperated SO-101 episodes (44 train / 5 validation by episode); top 1280x720 -> camera1, wrist 640x480 -> camera2, both resized with padding to 512; offline validation is action MAE on held-out episodes, not task success
